calls.title: Redis<>GrowthBook - Discussion
calls.summary: Redis (Keith Nyberg, demand gen/marketing, and Scott Weaver, engineer) is evaluating A/B testing tools after Mutiny's shutdown, seeking a server-side solution integrated with their Sanity CMS and GA4, with a simple UI for non-technical marketers, while avoiding costly LaunchDarkly experimentation pricing. GrowthBook (Jake Heier and Ashley Stirrup) presented their open-source platform with user-seat pricing, data
